items.title: Multi-agency response — Loughborough Town Hall
items.imageAlt: Fire, ambulance and specialist rescue units at Loughborough Town Hall during a multi-agency incident
items.summary: DispaUK-coordinated units on scene at Loughborough Town Hall after a structural rescue call during building works on the High Street — fast multi-agency mobilisation from our Leicestershire coverage.
items.body:
Loughborough Town Hall became the focus of a major multi-agency attendance this afternoon after crews were mobilised to a specialist rescue involving scaffolding and elevated work platforms on the High Street frontage.

DispaUK dispatch centres assigned fire appliances (including aerial ladder and specialist rescue), ambulance resources, and a team leader vehicle within minutes of the call being graded. Cordons were established while firefighters worked at height alongside colleagues in the hydraulic platform, with ambulance crews standing by for any casualties.

The rapid mobilisation reflects the value of pre-planned coverage across our Leicestershire stations and the ability of DispaUK control to vector the right mix of assets first time — pumps, aerials, specialist rescue and clinical support — rather than a slow build-up of resources.

No members of the public were reported seriously injured. The High Street remained partly closed while the incident was brought under control. All responding units operated under DispaUK coordination from the assigned dispatch centre covering the Loughborough area.

This report is published for the DispaUK / MissionChief community and does not represent a real-world emergency service press release.

items.title: Major Fire Breakout Prompts Large Emergency Response in Falsgrave
items.summary: Emergency services are currently at the scene of a serious building fire in Falsgrave, Scarborough, with eight fire engines and specialist support units deployed to tackle the blaze.
items.body:
Fire crews operate aerial platforms, water carriers, and command units as they work to contain a major structure fire in Falsgrave.

A major incident response is underway in Falsgrave, Scarborough, following a severe fire at a residential property earlier today. High plumes of smoke were visible across the area as flames quickly engulfed the structure, prompting a swift, large-scale deployment from local fire and rescue services.

Crews remain on scene actively battling the flames, securing the surrounding perimeter, and damping down hotspots. Local residents are advised to keep windows and doors closed due to heavy smoke in the immediate vicinity, while drivers are encouraged to avoid the area to allow emergency vehicles clear access.
